title: What the Bid–Ask Spread Costs
summary: An illustrative order book shows the cost of buying and immediately selling one share.

scenes.label: The quote
scenes.headline: One stock, two prices
scenes.detail: Illustrative quote with one share available on each side
scenes.narration: In this example, the highest bid is nineteen dollars and ninety-eight cents. The lowest asking price is twenty dollars and two cents.

scenes.label: The trade
scenes.headline: Buy at the ask, sell at the bid
scenes.detail: Illustrative one-share fills assuming the quote holds
scenes.narration: If the quote holds, an immediate buy fills at the ask and an immediate sale fills at the bid.

scenes.label: The spread
scenes.headline: Four cents across the spread
scenes.detail: Illustrative difference before commissions and fees
scenes.narration: The four-cent difference between those fills is the cost of that immediate round trip before commissions or fees.
